purpose: A Terraform bucket declares a public-read ACL.

groundTruth.rationale: acl = "public-read" makes every object readable by anyone with the URL, bypassing application authorization.

limitations: Terraform formatting varies; the rule tolerates whitespace but not expressions that build the ACL value.
